notes.value: Deepal L07, a four-door fastback sedan, per the Deepal Pakistan brochure: rear permanent-magnet motor with 190 kW (258 PS; deepal.com.pk quotes 255 hp) and 320 Nm, rear-wheel drive, 66.8 kWh ternary lithium (NMC) battery, 540 km NEDC. DC fast charging 30–80% in 35 minutes (87 kW peak per PakNEV); AC 7 kW; vehicle-to-load and smart regenerative braking. 0–100 km/h 5.9 s and 180 km/h per PakNEV, which estimates about 390 km in real-world use at 12.3 kWh/100 km. 4,820 × 1,890 × 1,480 mm on a 2,900 mm wheelbase, 150 mm ground clearance, 19-inch alloys on 245/45 R19, 473 L boot plus a front trunk, 1,760 kg, 5 seats. Equipment includes 6 airbags, a 360° camera with transparent chassis, a full ADAS suite (adaptive cruise with stop & go, AEB, lane keeping, blind-spot detection), a 14.6-inch touchscreen, AR head-up display, 14 speakers, a heat-resistant panoramic glass roof and ventilated, powered front seats. PKR 13,999,000 including freight, with a free 7 kW wall charger at launch. Warranty: battery 8 years / 240,000 km; vehicle 3 years / 100,000 km (PakNEV). Sold by Master Changan. Sources: Deepal Pakistan brochure and website, PakNEV.

DC fast charging 30–80% in 35 minutes (87 kW peak per PakNEV); AC 7 kW; vehicle-to-load and smart regenerative braking. 0–100 km/h 6.7 s, 180 km/h and 1,900 kg per PakNEV, which estimates about 360 km in real-world use at 13.8 kWh/100 km. 4,750 × 1,930 × 1,625 mm on a 2,900 mm wheelbase, 165 mm ground clearance, 20-inch alloys on 255/45 R20, 445 L boot plus a front trunk, 5 seats. notes.value: Deepal E07, the 'transformer' SUV with a convertible rear cargo section, as sold in Pakistan (single dual-motor AWD version), per the Deepal Pakistan brochure: 440 kW / 590 hp and 645 Nm (front asynchronous motor 188 kW / 280 Nm, rear permanent-magnet motor 252 kW / 365 Nm), 0–100 km/h in 3.96 s, 89.98 kWh ternary lithium battery, 590 km NEDC. DC up to 240 kW with 30–80% in 15 minutes; AC 6.6 kW; V2L 6.6 kW. Air suspension with continuous damping control, 5,045 × 1,996 × 1,695 mm on a 3,120 mm wheelbase, 183 mm ground clearance, 600 mm wading depth, 21-inch wheels on 265/45 R21, 524 L boot plus a 131 L front trunk. 210 km/h, 2,440 kg and about 429 km in real-world use per PakNEV. Equipment includes an electric partition glass and opening trunk-glass roof, zero-gravity ventilated front seats, ventilated rear seats, an 18-speaker system, 15.4-inch swivelling touchscreen, AR head-up display, automatic and remote parking, and a full ADAS suite with lane-centring. PKR 19,000,000. Battery warranty 8 years / 240,000 km (PakNEV). Sold by Master Changan. Sources: Deepal Pakistan brochure and website, PakNEV.

notes.value: Changan Nevo Hunter REEV PLUS 4X4, a range-extended double-cab pickup: a 2.0-litre turbo petrol engine (1,998 cc) works only as a generator, and two motors drive all four wheels. Per Master Changan's brochure: 240 kW (322 hp) and 529 Nm combined (front motor 110 kW / 209 Nm, rear 130 kW / 320 Nm), 31.18 kWh LFP battery, 131 km electric range (NEDC) and 900+ km combined with the 70 L tank. AC 6.6 kW, DC 41 kW with 30–80% in 30 minutes, 3.3 kW vehicle-to-load. 5,380 × 1,980 × 1,920 mm on a 3,180 mm wheelbase, 220 mm ground clearance, 18-inch wheels on 265/60 R18, cargo bed 1,590 × 1,580 × 490 mm, 1,010 kg payload, 2,500 kg towing, double-wishbone front and multi-link rear suspension. 0–100 km/h 7.9 s; 180 km/h and 2,710 kg per PakNEV. Equipment includes 6 airbags, a 3D around-view camera with recorder, cruise control, a 12.3-inch touchscreen with wireless CarPlay and Android Auto, ventilated front seats, a 40 W wireless charger and a power-boost mode. PKR 10,990,000; launched 20 August 2026, deliveries from October 2026 (full payment). Sold by Master Changan. Sources: Master Changan brochure and website, ProPakistani, PakNEV.
